channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Scientists find water fueled volcanoes 3 billion years ago
item.description: Ancient rocks from Western Australia suggest water reached deep inside Earth over three billion years ago, before modern plate tectonics.

item.title: Venus's pale yellow clouds may hide something surprisingly dark
item.description: A century-old mystery in Venus's clouds became more intriguing as scientists calculated how strongly the unidentified material behind its dark features absorbs light.

item.title: Researchers identify a natural mechanism that halts inflammation
item.description: Researchers have identified a natural braking system that enables the immune system to stop inflammation and prevent harmful immune cells from accumulating.

item.title: CERN observes unexpected gluon behavior within atomic nuclei
item.description: Physicists at CERN have developed a method to examine atomic nuclei closely and differentiate between two competing explanations for gluon behavior.
